content.user_title: Design a High-Performance Paid Ad Account
content.value_statement: Paid campaigns often lose efficiency through unclear roles, overlapping targeting, and weak exclusions. This skill creates a structured campaign plan with measurable audience controls.
actual_capabilities: Selects Search, Performance Max, or broad match based on goals, intent maturity, and asset readiness.
Maps campaigns into focused ad groups or asset groups with one intent theme per group.
Plans keyword match types, audience signals, placement exclusions, and cross-campaign negative keywords.
Reviews paid and organic query overlap using campaign and analytics exports.
Scores the ROAS Audience dimension and marks missing brand safety evidence as needing input.
Creates a user-confirmed structure plan and handoff summary for later account auditing.
limitations: It does not calculate final RQS scores or enforce account-level veto rules.
It does not allocate budgets or calculate campaign spend splits.
It depends on user-provided exports for account-specific recommendations and overlap analysis.
It does not change live advertising accounts or require platform API access.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Paid Account
use_cases.description: Choose campaign types and create a clear group structure before launch.

use_cases.title: Restructure an Existing Account
use_cases.description: Identify overlapping themes, weak exclusions, and unclear campaign roles from account exports.

use_cases.title: Review Paid and Organic Overlap
use_cases.description: Compare paid search themes with organic landing performance and flag low-incremental-value terms.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a paid account for [goal] on [platform]. Organize my themes into campaigns and focused groups: [themes].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a new account and a short list of marketing themes.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Campaign Type
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Search, Performance Max, and broad match for [goal]. Consider intent, creative readiness, feed quality, control, and reach.
prompt_templates.scenario: Select the right campaign approach before building account structure.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure from Search Terms
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign and search-terms export: [data]. Propose campaign roles, group themes, match types, negatives, audience signals, and exclusions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an active account using recent performance data.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Audience Quality and Cannibalization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these campaign, search-term, placement, and GA4 exports: [data]. Score ROAS Audience, audit paid-organic overlap, identify missing evidence, and prepare an auditor handoff.
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced structural review before a full account audit.

output_examples.input: Launch lead generation for enterprise payroll software using Search and five keyword themes.
output: Campaign role: separate branded demand from non-brand high-intent acquisition.
Group structure: one intent theme for integrations, compliance, migration, pricing, and alternatives.
Control plan: exact and phrase match first, with cross-campaign brand negatives and irrelevant employment exclusions.

output_examples.input: Review campaign and GA4 exports for paid versus organic overlap.
output: High overlap: branded help queries already receive strong organic traffic and show limited paid incremental value.
Keep paid coverage for high-conversion commercial terms where organic visibility remains weak.
Next input: provide the placements report before scoring brand and placement safety.

best_practices: Provide recent campaign, search-term, placement, and analytics exports when available.
State the campaign goal, target market, conversion action, and creative or feed readiness.
Review every proposed group for one clear intent and approve results before saving.
anti_patterns: Do not default to Performance Max without checking feed quality, assets, and control requirements.
Do not place overlapping keyword themes in several campaigns without explicit negatives.
Do not treat missing placement or audience evidence as a passing result.

faq.question: Does this skill change my live advertising account?
faq.answer: No. It creates a planning document from information and exports that you provide.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports general paid account planning, with detailed guidance for Search, Performance Max, broad match, and platform audience structures.

faq.question: Are advertising platform APIs required?
faq.answer: No. Manual exports are sufficient, while approved read-only integrations are optional.

faq.question: Can it calculate my budget allocation?
faq.answer: No. It delegates budget allocation to a dedicated budget optimization workflow.

faq.question: Can it produce a final account quality score?
faq.answer: No. It scores the Audience dimension and passes the result to a full account auditor.

faq.question: How does it handle incomplete data?
faq.answer: It identifies missing exports, marks unsupported checks as needing input, and avoids passing controls without evidence.
